note: An f16 128x128x64 matmul on the Hopper warp-group tier: eight warps (two warp groups) stack along M, one m64n64k16 instruction per warp row spans the eight 16x8 accumulator cells, K arrives in 64-element chunks through a two-slot TMA ring. Both operands are read through shared-memory matrix descriptors. evidence: the corpus's sm_120 f16-mma-*-tma cases realize the same TMA ring under mma.sync; the descriptor layout is the 128-byte swizzle the ring already deposits (plans/hopper-wgmma.md, "Where things stand").
